descriptionFr: Gite d etape au village de Catastaghju (Serra di Fiumorbu). Demi-pension possible, 20 places.
descriptionEn: Guesthouse in the village of Catastaghju (Serra di Fiumorbu). Half-board available, 20 beds.

descriptionFr: Point d eau potable en bord de sentier, dernier ravitaillement avant la montee.
descriptionEn: Drinking water point along the trail, last supply before the climb.

descriptionFr: Vue degagee sur la plaine orientale et la mer Tyrrhenienne depuis le col.
descriptionEn: Open view over the eastern plain and the Tyrrhenian Sea from the pass.

descriptionFr: Anciennes bergeries en pierre, temoins de la vie pastorale corse. Source a proximite.
descriptionEn: Ancient stone sheepfolds, witnesses of Corsican pastoral life. Spring nearby.

descriptionFr: Traversee d une magnifique foret de pins laricio, espece endemique corse pouvant atteindre 50m.
descriptionEn: Walk through a magnificent Laricio pine forest, endemic Corsican species reaching up to 50m.

descriptionFr: Petit commerce de ravitaillement au village. Pain frais, charcuterie corse, fromage.
descriptionEn: Small supply shop in the village. Fresh bread, Corsican charcuterie, cheese.

descriptionFr: Gite d etape au coeur du village, 16 places. Cuisine commune, demi-pension.
descriptionEn: Guesthouse in the heart of the village, 16 beds. Shared kitchen, half-board.
